notes.title: 2022 Update
notes.content:
Greetings Golden Retrievers and welcome to our first development update! My brother and I have been having a great time developing the game this summer. The game has officially been in development for over a year now! We've been testing out new ideas and refining old ones. We think you'll be happy with the progress and we'd like to update you on the game. 

[h1]Where We Were Last Summer[/h1]
Last summer was the very beginning of the games development. We had implemented and tested the initial concept of gameplay. We figured out what was fun, and what wasn't. Made modifications, and implemented features from the feedback we got. We took down the old demo and are currently working on the newer demo.

[h1]Golden Retriever Today![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40915573/a7fc05bb019d7197d7145f6a16672380dcbf165f.png[/img]

[h2]Updates and Improvements Made So Far:[/h2]
[h3]Enemy Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Dinos[/b] spawn from black sludge instead of randomly
[*] [b]Waste bags[/b] will explode after a few minutes and create black sludge
[*] [b]Dinos[/b] eat [b]gold nuggets[/b] and [b]gold coins[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Processing Gold Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bags of [b]Gold dirt[/b] turn into [b]gold nuggets[/b] and must then be smelted into [b]gold coins[/b].
[*] Your washplant needs both [b]gas[/b] and [b]water[/b] to run.
[/list]

[h3]Recycling Bin[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gives you [b]coal[/b] now when you insert [b]waste dirt[/b]
[*] Can recycle [b]Dino[/b] Prisoners for [b]fossils[/b]
[*] [b]Waste bags [/b]do not give you negative [b]coins[/b] any longer
[/list]

[h3]New Rent and Puppies Systems[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fat Cat collects his rent from your [b]ATM[/b] every month now.
[*] Puppies are born every month and require resources to grow.
[*] Puppies can become workers and soldiers.
[/list]

[h3]Underground[/h3]
[list]
[*] New [b]block[/b] types
[*] New hazards
[*] Improved artwork
[/list]

[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed Inventory system
[*] Changed layout of UI
[*] Added energy bar
[/list]


We will only be posting major updates on the Steam hub. If you are interested in seeing more behind the scenes progress and gameplay, please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/CoreReactStudio] Twitter. [/url] 

Until next time and have a great remaining summer!

-Luke
